apps.name: Punch Kick Duck+ (Apple Arcade)
apps.localizedDescription:
Fighting is all about timing. Just ask any duck.

The right move + right time = swift victory.

All you need to do is PUNCH KICK DUCK!

The cruel Baron Tigrisso has imprisoned you in his tower. Fight hordes of the Baron’s hench-critters as you battle up the tower to confront your captor.

Responsive controls and fast-paced action mean you'll soon be sending foes flying in this intense score-chaser. But be warned, your enemies are as determined as they are numerous, so you'll need to think quick and act quicker!!

Just remember the three golden rules, passed down by countless generations of ducks:

PUNCH beats KICK
KICK beats DUCK
DUCK beats PUNCH

Oh, and don’t forget to RUN. You don’t want to meet The BEAR.

PUNCH KICK D
